result.brief: 提出可控世界动作模型，用模拟器执行扰动动作并配对噪声视觉结果，配合扭曲视频-动作噪声调度与多智能体动作接口，提升动作预测、视频-动作一致性与指令可控性。
result.reason: Jointly predicts actions and visual futures with controllable world action modeling, simulator-based counterfactual video-action pairing, and multi-agent streams—directly a video world model with action conditioning.
